decisions.reason: The one-hour due-diligence arrangement changes the preliminary assessment method and outputs, not the required style-system coverage across the Word templates.
Testing templates during the assessment may examine copy-paste errors, but the source does not change the existing legacy copy-paste stability behavior, test sources, or target version.
The request to identify and document template errors does not resolve the existing table-adjustment ambiguity or change the required table-layout behavior.
The assessment plan does not change any bullet-size, balance, alignment, or scaling requirement.
The source changes only the preliminary assessment engagement and does not modify Tab-key or list-hierarchy behavior.
Documenting errors during due diligence does not change the requirement that manual line breaks work reliably after pasted content.
